services.name: Eco Tour
services.desc: Duration 2 Hours About Join our crew aboard The Opa and The Lola for a two-hour Eco Tour discovering wildlife in one of the most ecologically biodiverse ecosystems in the Northern Hemisphere. The Indian River Lagoon is home to over 4,200 different species of plants, animals, and fish. More Info Wheelchair Accessible and Handicapped Friendly. 10% OFF for Seniors 65 and Over, Brevard County Residents and Military. Must show proof of ID upon arrival. All tours depart from Kelly Park East. If you have a service animal, you must reserve all seats (6) on the tour. services.name: Sunset Cruises
services.desc: Duration 2 Hours About Are you looking for something unique and romantic to spark your inspiration? At Banana River Boat Tours, we offer a variety of tours to help create an unforgettable experience with your family. Begin your evening with a relaxing, enjoyable two-hour Cape Canaveral Sunset Cruise on the Banana River. Once aboard, sit back, relax and soak in the spectacular views of barrier islands and uninhabited spoil islands while watching the sun dip closer to the horizon. Our knowledgeable crew will point out local points of interest along the way. services.name: Bioluminescence Early Tour
services.desc: Duration 2 Hours ONLY AVAILABLE JUNE - SEPTEMBER About These tours are a unique way to experience nature and see some of the most beautiful creatures in the world at night. Bioluminescence occurs seasonally in our area when the water reaches a certain temperature… very, very warm. It’s an amazing sight to behold and something that you will never forget. A natural occurring phenomenon. During these tours, you can relax on a pontoon boat through waters that are teeming with bioluminescence. Banana River Boat Tours offer a unique opportunity different from most companies. services.name: Rocket Launch
services.desc: Duration 2 Hours About 5, 4, 3, 2, 1…we have liftoff. Don’t miss the next rocket launch viewing from the water. You’ll be onboard our pontoon boat, as close as you can get by water, to one of the most earth-shaking events you’ll ever witness. Join us for an upcoming rocket launch. We depart from Kelly Park. This is one of Brevard County’s finest Public Parks, where you can park your car while you go on the tour. Feel the excitement of those around you. See and hear the engines fire up. Feel the rumbling grow until the water and boat begin to tremble. Watch as lift-off occurs. Follow the bright orange in the sky.
